newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares close down on light profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares close down on light profit-taking.

text.p: Brazilian stocks closed down in moderate trade as blue-chip prices were hit by profit-taking after strong recent gains and investors showed caution ahead of Friday's release of U.S. economic data, brokers said.
"It dropped at the end," one local broker said. "It was a normal technical correction, profit-taking, because we've risen a lot."
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index .BVSP of 49 most-traded shares closed down 0.88 percent at 9,733 points in moderate trade of 567.5 million reais ($535.4 million).
